hardware.cpu: AMD EPYC-Rome Processor (KVM guest), 16 vCPU, about 30 GiB RAM
hardware.provider: shared agent host, loaded by other lanes and services during every run
hardware.pinning: taskset -c 12-15 (4 cores) for every build and registered run
hardware.heavy_job_gate: not used, as registered in PREREG.md (the lane's task rules: build and test only, no heavy slot)

seeds_note: no run draws randomness: planning calls, verifier calls on stored proofs and the table tool are deterministic up to wall times (runs/compare/n2-touched.txt lists every line shape that the normalisation touched)

runs.served_form: served_runs.py: verifier/tests/served_form_test.py on prover/tests/configurations/pinned_no_proof_of_work, 5 runs per tree, alternating main, head (runs/served/main-1..5.log, head-1..5.log, table.md, runs.tsv, summary.json)
runs.dense_files_under_both_binaries: served_runs.py, second part: the 14 case folders of the group routed-experts, as the head tree's first run wrote them, under the main and the head binary, one planning call each (runs/served/dense-files.tsv; the parameter files and the SHA-256 of all three files of each case in runs/served/dense-files/)
runs.table_tool: tool_identity.py: scales/policy_tables.py of both trees on the 9 parameter files under prover/examples/ and prover/tests/configurations/, 3 modes, and on the dense file (runs/tool/)
runs.stored_proofs: experiments/20261112-135-dense-standard-form/compare2.py, unchanged, 5 rounds per binary alternating main, head: 120 runs (runs/compare/: summary.json, runs.tsv, n2-touched.txt, and the raw outputs of round 0; the raw outputs of rounds 1 to 4 are not committed, their SHA-256 are in runs.tsv)
runs.suite: run_suite.py cpu with the PREREG's expression, --jobs 4, once per tree (runs/suite/main.log, head.log, with the work folder written as <WORK> and the tree as <REPO>)
runs.mutants_secondary: mutant_runs.py: the head binary and three builds with one table entry moved by 1, on the unmodified files of dense-with-digests and dense (runs/mutants/)

not_run: any GPU row; verifier.served.form.world.kit was left out by the runner on both trees (it needs nvcc or a GPU)
